description: Rank tracked storage by price per terabyte (unit "tb") or memory by price per gigabyte (unit "gb"), cheapest first. Unit prices are in pence. Each row carries its 90-day low, the number of recorded prices behind it, and an at-low or near-low verdict. The unit is required because the two scales cannot be compared.

category.description: Restrict to one or more categories within the chosen unit.

unit.description: "tb" for storage (hdd, ssd, nvme, external, usb), "gb" for memory (ram).

name: get_best_value
title: Best value storage and memory
